title: Cognitive Electrophysiology in Socioeconomic Context in Adulthood: An EEG dataset
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 127 young adults (18-30 years) collected to investigate links between childhood and adulthood socioeconomic status (SES) and cognitive electrophysiology. EEG tasks were derived from the ERP CORE resource and adapted to capture neural activity related to perception, cognition, and action. The dataset also includes retrospective and current SES indicators, and an ADHD symptoms checklist, enabling investigation of relationships between socioeconomic diversity, ADHD symptoms, and neural activity.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a Brain Products actiCHamp Plus system with BrainVision Recorder (v1.25.0101) and a 32-channel actiCAP slim active electrode system mounted per the international 10/20 system. The ground electrode was placed at FPz, two electrodes were repurposed for mastoid referencing, and three electrodes recorded EOG (horizontal and vertical). Data were sampled at 500 Hz and referenced to Cz. StimTrak was used to assess stimulus presentation delays (~20 ms) for visual and auditory stimuli.
